integration_path: Native game-authored left/right eye Draw/DrawIndexed source recorder borrows exact frame-owned private depth/stencil from the acknowledged shared GPU transport ring.

Ring depth allocations are lazy per-slot/per-eye, never reused until prior producer fence or consumer ACK safely releases the slot; DSV is cleared for both eyes at each camera frame and retired on shutdown.
WARP transport regression verifies real D24S8 DSV pair residency across frame recycling and denies wrong device/frame or pending fence.
